name: Canovelles (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a light blue bend one third of the height in width from the upper hoist to the lower fly.
history: The flag was approved on 8 May 2007 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4891 of 25 May 2007; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with a light blue bend 1/3 of the height in width; the colours of the flag and the arms come from the kit of the municipal football club.

features.role: bend one third of the height wide from the upper hoist to the lower fly
